svg.title: F32-4 Meter verification sheet as printed: B2-DH3-LVMSB-A1 meter M-A1 (PM8000)
svg.text: series through test block, same CTs
Enter the CT ratio 4000/5 in the reference so that it reads primary values; open and close the test block links in the order on the block label.
Take three readings within 10 s of each other at each load point and use the mean; repeat later at a higher load where the load cannot be set.
F32-4 Meter verification sheet as printed: B2-DH3-LVMSB-A1 meter M-A1 (PM8000)
Test load 2,048.7 kW · CT 4000/5 A class 0.5S · tolerance kW ±0.5 %, V ±0.3 %, A ±0.5 % · reference analyser 0.05 % class · worst error +0.32 % at 10 % load
• All five load points of M-A1 are inside ±0.5 % on kW; the largest error is at the lowest load.
• Feeder meter M-F07 failed at 10 % load (+1.8 % against ±1.0 %) until the CT leads were increased from 2.5 mm² to 4 mm², then read +0.6 %.
